test_title: PYST 4 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 13 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Change the following sentence into the Active form.**

Let the emergency meeting be convened at 10 AM without delay.

options.text: Convene the emergency meeting at 10 AM without delay.
The emergency meeting should be convened at 10 AM without delay.
They will convene the emergency meeting at 10 AM without delay.
An emergency meeting is convened at 10 AM without delay.

solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. Convene the emergency meeting at 10 AM without delay.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the **passive voice**, where the subject is not performing the action but is instead receiving the action.
 
• The goal is to convert the sentence into the **active voice**, where the subject performs the action.
 
• The phrase **"Let the emergency meeting be convened"** in passive voice changes to **"Convene the emergency meeting"** in active voice.
 
• Option 1 accurately reflects the active voice construction.

Correct sentence: *Convene the emergency meeting at 10 AM without delay.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Passive voice structure:** Object + be + past participle + (by subject).
 
• **Active voice structure:** Subject + verb + object.
 
• When converting from passive to active, identify the doer of the action (subject) and restructure the sentence accordingly.
